title: The form
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The form. Name, address, statement of purpose. Wood fills in name and address. The statement of purpose is a box. He draws in it. The strip shows the box, not the drawing.

panels.composition: The desk. A form, official, the letterhead as blocks. WOOD with a pen. Name and address filled, in the display face, too big for the lines.

image.prompt: a young man at a desk filling in an official form with lettering too large for its lines, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letterhead as blocks. Letter after: nothing; the name is too big to read.

panels.composition: STATEMENT OF PURPOSE: a box, empty. The pen hovering.

image.prompt: close on an empty ruled box on a form with a pen hovering above it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pen drawing in the box. The strip shows the pen, the box's edge, not what's in it.

image.prompt: close on a pen drawing inside a boxed area on a form, the drawing itself hidden by the hand, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The form in an envelope. Wood licking it. The corkboard behind: the ferry postcard, picture out.

image.prompt: a young man sealing an envelope at a desk with a corkboard behind him pinned with a ferry postcard, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The statement of purpose is a drawing. Reserved what.
